name: Hazevale, Burned
description: What the fire left of a mountain village: black timbers, drifting ash, and a silence where the fog used to be.

village_square.name: Burned Square
village_square.description: The well still stands in a ring of scorched stone. Every house around the square is a shell, and ash drifts down over everything like grey snow. A path of cinders leads south, toward the sound of crying.

buried_lane.name: Lane of Cinders
buried_lane.description: A lane of burned cottages, their doors fallen in. Nothing moves here.

shrine.name: Village Shrine
shrine.description: A stone shrine with a ring of small offerings around its base. The fire went around it. Everything else is ash, but here the stones are only dusty, and a candle still burns.
